answer: A practical defence is Signed credit card tenure with card issuer attestation. It rests on years the issuer recorded one holder across cards, which gives every honest agent a thread that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so years the issuer recorded one holder across cards stays private; the sable is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. The defence holds because the cost is per identity and the reward is per identity too — the sparrow cancels out, and the farm is left with nothing but the bill.
